scope: Production build; loopback HTTP; isolated database; graceful and abrupt process restarts
checks: Fresh runtime seeds a diverse published synthetic catalogue once
Unknown demo personas and caller-provided owner identities are rejected
Private API routes require student sessions and operator routes require reviewer sessions
Cross-origin, missing-origin, malformed JSON and oversized mutations fail closed
Separate protected cookies establish fixed demo sessions without granting other roles
Consent and valid minimal preferences are required before persistent onboarding
Profile changes persist with optimistic concurrency and reject stale updates
Stored matching returns eligible explained opportunities without confidence claims
An unmet school-credit requirement returns no matches rather than invented approval
Public search and combined filters run before pagination and reject invalid ranges
Repeated save and removal actions are idempotent and cannot cross personas
Repeated destination previews create one OPENED demo event, never an application
Future attendance, forged owners and foreign activity IDs are rejected
Application self-reports have append-only versioned history and safe stale conflicts
The labeled historical sample supports truthful self-reported attendance after its end
In-app alerts default off and opt-in/read/dismiss/opt-out persist
Dashboard and export contain only the signed persona’s current local data
Operator outcomes expose aggregates without identities, private preferences or confirmation claims
Organizations, integrations and matching QA report the actual synthetic local state
Source pause suppresses public discovery, matches, signup actions and imports immediately
Paused sources produce unavailable reminders and cannot be falsely resolved
Invalid catalogue edits fail, material edits return to draft, and stale writes conflict
Withdrawal removes availability and restoration requires a fresh review
Unknown-age and expired/cancelled records stay blocked, rejection remains private
Fixture replay writes immutable import history and preserves record identity
Community publication controls affect the public front door without claiming a partner
Structured feedback is owned, idempotent and separate from self-reported activity
Graceful restart preserves edited supply, audit and private state while invalidating old sessions
Abrupt restart preserves acknowledged writes and does not replay or overwrite the seed
Confirmed profile deletion removes all owned private data and leaves the other persona intact
Deleting and recreating a profile cannot revive an old version
Session logout removes access while leaving saved synthetic state available on reselection
limitations: Fixed selectable personas are a local demonstration, not production authentication. Process recovery is not a power-loss, backup, or deployment proof.
